question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**among**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage highlights India's efforts to address issues of nutritional deprivation, ill-health, and lost potential, particularly for women and children.
 
• The blank requires a preposition that connects the record of deprivation to the group of citizens affected.
 
• "**Among**" is the best fit, as it denotes the presence of these issues within the population of Indian citizens.
